resources.title: Lelañea — films and reading, in her own words

provenance.note: The shape of the resources drawer (f-resources t-74). The two passages here are verbatim excerpts of her authored material, chosen by the builder as a starting point and awaiting her confirmation or replacement; the film and reading lists are empty because no film of hers exists yet and only she can say which pieces belong beside which module. Her list lands in t-76.

notes: Every `words` passage is a verbatim excerpt of a source this repository already holds, and a test proves it character for character. Nothing here is drafted in her register: the drawer says these are her words, so they are.
Keys are module ids as in lelanea_module_structure.json, plus `journey`, `situations` and `default`. A key with no words of its own falls back to `default`.

`relatesTo` on a film or a reading names the module id it belongs beside, or `journey`, `situations`, or null for a piece that belongs to everything. The drawer shows what belongs to the open thing first, then what belongs to everything: two films, three readings.
A film links out (`href`); there is no inline player until where her films are hosted is decided. A reading is either a foundational document (`documentId`) or a link (`href`), never both.

module_01_values.quote: If you don't shape your values, the world will shape them for you.
paragraphs: When you know your values deeply — not as nice words on a wall, but as lived principles — you become centered, congruent, and grounded in your being.
You are no longer a sponge soaking up the expectations of the world. You become an anchor.

default.quote: Whatever it is that brought you here, you listened.
paragraphs: This is not simply an app.
An invitation to explore the relationship you have with yourself, your consciousness, and the magnificent intelligence that has always existed beneath the noise of the human experience.
